entries.message: Making a Split View from a single tab now asks you to select at least 2 tabs, instead of asking for fewer.
iPhone, iPad and Mac decide the address field's padlock with one rule that reads the security Crest judged for the page.
When Crest can't save your session, Sync settings says why in plain words instead of showing an internal code.
Mac dialogs and save panels, sync and password-import messages, and the sidebar's media card text go through the string catalog so they can be translated.
A folder or Space without a name is called Untitled Folder or Untitled Space wherever it comes from, including storage and sync.
Importing another browser's passwords brings those for sites without HTTPS too, and setup says Crest won't fill them in, instead of leaving them out without a word.
